name: browser-ai-copilot
description: Production-grade Browser AI Copilot Chrome Extension with ReAct agent loop

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=apps/extension && npm install --workspace=apps/backend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/extension && npm run build --workspace=apps/backend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=apps/backend && npm run test:unit --workspace=apps/extension
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --workspace=apps/extension && npm run test --workspace=apps/backend
